## About

::: {.lede}
I am a fifth-year PhD student in economics at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, originally from Charleston, SC. I work on public finance, computational methods, and macroeconomics.
:::

My current research studies the taxation of capital and bequests, high-skill immigration, and flood insurance. Earlier work includes open-source modeling for [inverse-optimal tax methods](https://github.com/PSLmodels/InverseOptimalTax/tree/main) and [reducing bias in machine-learning estimators](https://www.banglajol.info/index.php/JStR/article/view/67466/45250).

Before my PhD, I completed a BS in Economics, Mathematics, and Statistics at the University of South Carolina (the real USC). [Go Gamecocks!]{.gamecocks}

Questions? Email me at [john.p.ryan@wisc.edu](mailto:john.p.ryan@wisc.edu).
